pricing_notes: Most 7-night totals below were read from Booking.com room-rate tables for 2 adults, 1 room, in USD on 2026-11-26; two Shanghai luxury benchmarks were captured 2026-11-25 (per-window dates are shown). Rates are dynamic and exclude China VAT (6% or 6.6% as stated per listing); service-charge inclusion is shown per property. In the dated quote captures, listed room types matched the private/attached-bathroom and queen/king filters. This provisional shortlist is not ordered or certified by hotel-to-venue journey time. Exact totals, room availability, taxes, and cancellation terms must be rechecked at booking; these third-party rate captures are not hotel-direct offers.

booking_timing_finding.headline: Purchase timing is unknown; compare exact-date refundable rates. One captured quote cannot identify the cheapest booking day.
evidence: The 2026-11-26 Booking.com capture showed base-Beijing Wangfujing at $425 for Feb 15–22 against a displayed $866 reference price; the quote is date- and room-specific and may change.
Park Plaza Beijing Wangfujing was captured at $749 for Feb 15–22 and Mar 1–8, versus $924 for Mar 16–23; this compares stay dates, not purchase dates.
Radisson Blu Shanghai New World was captured at $921 for Feb 15–22 and $1,438 for Mar 16–23; this is a dated quote comparison, not a forecast.
Pullman Shanghai Jing’an was captured at $621 non-refundable / $707 free-cancel for Feb 15–22, versus $845 / $963 for Mar 16–23; terms are specific to the captured room rate.
Grand Central Hotel Shanghai was captured at $901 for Feb 15–22 versus $974 for Mar 16–23. These five examples do not establish a market-wide minimum or future rate.
booking_timing_finding.action: Re-run the exact check-in/out and room search on the live Booking.com page before booking. Confirm queen/king availability, private bathroom, final tax-inclusive total, cancellation deadline, and payment schedule. These snapshots do not show the cheapest day to purchase or guarantee that a shown rate remains available.

proximity_methodology: The requested hotel-to-restaurant/activity limit is ≤60 minutes by subway/bus. No complete, date-specific official route matrix for the listed hotels and destinations was verified. The MICHELIN reach field is intentionally blank for every property; no hotel is certified as meeting the ≤60-minute limit. District counts and station proximity are not journey times. Hotel order is a provisional comparison of dated quote snapshots, property location, and listed amenities only; it is not a route-based recommendation. See GAP-08 before selecting a base.
